en: Colorized aerial view of a historic spa town nestled in a valley, surrounded by forested hills and open fields. The foreground shows dense blocks of ornate multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs, red and gray roof tiles, and a small park. On the left there is a church with a tall spire. The town curves along a river or canal on the right side. At the top left of the image, in red capital letters, is the printed title 'KARLSBAD Westend'.
